If the web ConfigMap in the demo namespace is deleted, it will break the web Deployment, which relies on it. The Deployment will not be able to start new Pods, and existing Pods may fail if they depend on the ConfigMap. Additionally, the Service and Endpoints associated with the web Deployment may also be affected. 

Here is a list of the resources that will be affected:
* Deployment: demo/web
* Service: demo/web
* Endpoints: demo/web
* Pods: demo/web-6bf59bd6f6-bnclz, demo/web-6bf59bd6f6-f7m9p, demo/web-6bf59bd6f6-rw5tq 

These resources are all in the demo namespace.
